notes.title: Day 1 Patch - Live
notes.content:
A big THANK YOU to everyone who played on launch day!

It was very entertaining to watch the streams and see people discovering the world we created.

This is our first patch, it fixes small issues and visual glitches:

[list]
[*] fixed faulty stove in the kitchen that would trigger incorrect cutscene
[*] removed floating mop in the storage room
[*] deleted weird standing woman outside the restaurant
[*] Power outlet now shuts off with power
[*] Fixed issue in the menu after completing the game
[*] Miscellaneous and other small fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Gameplay Livestream!
notes.content:
[h1]About the game [/h1]

At Tony's is a first-person horror experience taking place in a haunted pizzeria. 

The last night shift worker vanished mysteriously, it's your turn to step in to help the family's.

[h1]Developer Livestream [/h1]

Come watch us play the demo (also available to download for free). 

We'll be sharing details about the game, storyline, environments and more!

We hope to see you there,

Good Sleep Games.
